```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Load packages}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(car)
```

```{r Load data}
source("00_preprocess.R")
# TreeData now has: BA zeros → NA, outlier fix, DBH back-calculated
```

```{r Plot-level total BA — year 3}
ba_plot <- TreeData %>%
  filter(!is.na(BA_year_3)) %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number) %>%
  summarise(Total_BA = sum(BA_year_3, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ba_plot$Treatment <- factor(ba_plot$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))

avg_plot_BA <- ba_plot %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_BA = mean(Total_BA, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_BA = sd(Total_BA, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Model total BA}
model_ba <- lmer(Total_BA ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = ba_plot)
summary(model_ba)
anova(model_ba)

means_ba <- emmeans(model_ba, pairwise ~ Treatment | Site, type = "response")
cld_ba <- as.data.frame(cld(means_ba$emmeans, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))

means_ba_pooled <- emmeans(model_ba, pairwise ~ Treatment, type = "response")
cld_ba_pooled <- as.data.frame(cld(means_ba_pooled$emmeans, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r Plot total BA — by site}
ggplot(avg_plot_BA, aes(x = Treatment, y = Avg_BA, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(Avg_BA - SD_BA, 0), ymax = Avg_BA + SD_BA),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(data = ba_plot, aes(x = Treatment, y = Total_BA),
              color = "black", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.1) +
  geom_text(data = cld_ba, family = "sans", show.legend = FALSE,
            check_overlap = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 1,
            aes(x = Treatment, y = Inf, label = .group)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("12SP" = "darkolivegreen", "2SP" = "darkseagreen2",
                               "6SP" = "darkseagreen", "M1" = "firebrick",
                               "M2" = "coral"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = expression("Total Basal Area (" * cm^2 * ")")) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("total_BA_year3.jpeg", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Plot-level mean height — year 3}
ht_plot <- TreeData %>%
  filter(!is.na(Height_year_3)) %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number) %>%
  summarise(mean_ht = mean(Height_year_3, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ht_plot$Treatment <- factor(ht_plot$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))

model_ht <- lmer(mean_ht ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = ht_plot)
summary(model_ht)
anova(model_ht)
```

```{r Identify monoculture species}
MonocultureSpecies <- TreeData %>%
  filter(Treatment == "M1") %>%
  select(Site, Species) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r Calculate RGR — exclude sites without year 2 data}
# GAM has no year 2 data, so RGR can only be computed for FAB, FCEA, LLFS
TreeData_RGR <- TreeData %>%
  filter(!is.na(Height_year_2), !is.na(Height_year_3),
         !is.na(BA_year_2), !is.na(BA_year_3),
         Height_year_2 > 0, Height_year_3 > 0,
         BA_year_2 > 0, BA_year_3 > 0)

TreeData_RGR <- TreeData_RGR %>%
  mutate(
    RGR_Height = (log(Height_year_3) - log(Height_year_2)) / 365,
    RGR_BA = (log(BA_year_3) - log(BA_year_2)) / 365
  )
```

```{r Inga edulis performance across treatments}
# Subset to Inga edulis (present in M1 at all sites)
Inga_data <- TreeData %>%
  filter(Species == "Inga edulis", !is.na(Height_year_3), !is.na(BA_year_3))

Inga_data$Treatment <- factor(Inga_data$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))

# Individual-level BA
cat("=== Inga edulis individual BA ===\n")
model_inga_ba <- lmer(BA_year_3 ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = Inga_data)
anova(model_inga_ba)

# Individual-level height
cat("=== Inga edulis individual height ===\n")
model_inga_ht <- lmer(Height_year_3 ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = Inga_data)
anova(model_inga_ht)

# RGR height (only sites with year 2 data)
Inga_RGR <- TreeData_RGR %>%
  filter(Species == "Inga edulis")
Inga_RGR$Treatment <- factor(Inga_RGR$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))

if (nrow(Inga_RGR) > 0) {
  cat("=== Inga edulis RGR height ===\n")
  model_inga_rgr <- lmer(RGR_Height ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = Inga_RGR)
  anova(model_inga_rgr)
}
```

```{r Inga vs other species summary}
# Separate Inga from other species for comparison plots
Inga_summary <- TreeData %>%
  filter(!is.na(BA_year_3), !is.na(Height_year_3)) %>%
  mutate(Species_group = ifelse(Species == "Inga edulis", "Inga edulis", "Other species")) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Species_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_BA = mean(BA_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BA = sd(BA_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Height = mean(Height_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_Height = sd(Height_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Inga_summary$Treatment <- factor(Inga_summary$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))
print(Inga_summary)
```

```{r Plot Inga vs other species — BA}
ggplot(Inga_summary, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_BA, color = Species_group, group = Species_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_BA - sd_BA, 0), ymax = mean_BA + sd_BA),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Inga edulis" = "darkorange", "Other species" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = expression("Mean Individual BA (" * cm^2 * ")"), color = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14))

ggsave("inga_vs_others_BA.jpeg", width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Plot Inga vs other species — Height}
ggplot(Inga_summary, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_Height, color = Species_group, group = Species_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_Height - sd_Height, 0), ymax = mean_Height + sd_Height),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Inga edulis" = "darkorange", "Other species" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Individual Height (cm)", color = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14))

ggsave("inga_vs_others_height.jpeg", width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
